purpose: Registration #3785 / release #3072 / incident #4445: make the independently authorized read-only production SSH host-key attestation resilient to self-hosted marketplace-action or artifact transport failures by using a shell-only local production job and hex-encoded public fingerprint evidence. No trust-anchor change or production mutation is authorized.
requiredBehavior: run only from exact owner command /production p0-ssh-host-attest-v3 current-main on incident authority #4445
require a non-empty protected PC_PROD_SSH_PORT and scan only canonical REG.RU IPv4 195.19.12.120 after DNS confirmation
require three byte-identical non-empty hosted ssh-keyscan observations before accepting an external public-key set
encode only public canonical host-key evidence as hex before using GitHub job outputs so an observed fingerprint equal to the protected pin cannot be redacted or altered by exact secret masking
run the production-side attestation as a shell-only job on the pre-existing restricted labels self-hosted, linux, x64, pc-prod and tai-readonly with no checkout, artifact action or repository secret
verify non-root and no-direct-Docker runner boundary and attest only root-owned non-writable public /etc/ssh/ssh_host_*_key.pub files
require every externally observed algorithm/fingerprint pair to exist in the local production host-key authority
classify the protected stored pin only in the final hosted job and never transport or publish that protected stored value
publish one deterministic replacement public fingerprint only when the stored pin is independently proven stale and the replacement differs from it
bind hosted contract and final classifier to one exact current main SHA and publish PRODUCTION_MUTATION=NONE
forbiddenCapabilities: changing, deleting or automatically accepting PC_PROD_SSH_HOST_FINGERPRINT or any GitHub secret
StrictHostKeyChecking=no, accept-new, UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null, password SSH or any authenticated SSH session
reading SSH private host keys or production private keys
sudo, Docker mutation, systemctl mutation, service restart, deployment, migration or production filesystem mutation
database, customer-data, password-reset, mail-send, MFA, TOTP, session, role, tenant or reviewer mutation
publisher execution for non-owner, unrelated or malformed issue comments
new paid provider, SaaS subscription or recurring cost
unrelated PC-CROP business-flow, Gekta, Company OS or showroom behavior changes
acceptanceEvidence: workflow syntax, project lock and focused shell-only contract pass
three stable hosted public-key scans on the non-empty protected SSH port
restricted production runner publishes only hex-encoded canonical public host-key evidence and uses no marketplace actions
final hosted classifier proves external keys are a subset of local root-owned public host-key authority
stored pin is classified CURRENT or STALE without publishing the protected old value
replacement public fingerprint is published only for independently proven STALE classification
result states PRODUCTION_MUTATION=NONE and does not count as registration acceptance
